name: Supplier Qualification Pipeline
description: End-to-end workflow for qualifying suppliers. Covers supplier discovery, document analysis, RFQ outreach, response analysis, audits, and selection tasks.

stages.name: Supplier Discovery
stages.description: Search and identify potential suppliers based on product/service criteria

stages.name: Supplier Document Analysis
stages.description: Analyze supplier documents, catalogs, and market reports

stages.name: RFQ Outreach
stages.description: Send Request for Quotation emails to shortlisted suppliers

stages.name: Response Analysis
stages.description: Track supplier responses and rank based on criteria

stages.name: Qualification Audit
stages.description: Audit shortlisted suppliers on facility, quality, capacity, and compliance

stages.name: Selection Tasks
stages.description: Manage final selection tasks and coordination
